beats.en: A moment, please. The child comes first.

as.guan: 官人可是酒後不適？稍候。
as.shi: 相公面色發白，可是苦讀傷神？

asEn.guan: Feeling poorly after wine, sir? A moment.
asEn.shi: You look pale, young sir. Too much study?
asEn.seng: Come for medicine too, Master? A moment.
asEn.fu: Don't worry, madam. This lady is first.
asEn.tong: Little one, hands off the medicine chest.
asEn.jun: Soldier, did the drink get you?
asEn.li: What ails you, brother? A moment.

beats.text: 太丞，孩兒夜裏發熱，哭了一宿。
beats.en: Physician, the child had a fever and cried all night.
Don't fret. Let me feel the brow.
Mama… scared…

beats.text: 還有我家丈夫，昨夜又醉了。
beats.en: And my husband got drunk again last night.

beats.text: 門外牌上寫著：治酒所傷。
beats.en: The sign outside says it: for harm done by wine.
Back again? Is it Incense Pills you want?

as.guan: 官人又來？昨夜又醉了罷。
as.jun: 軍爺又來？營裏又吃酒了？

asEn.guan: Back, sir? Drunk again last night, I take it.
asEn.jun: Back, soldier? More drinking in camp?

beats.text: 治酒所傷真方集香丸，好長的名兒。
beats.en: 'True remedy, Incense Pills, for harm done by wine': a long name.

beats.text: 前頭正店腳店，天天滿座。
beats.en: The wine houses and taverns ahead are full every day.

beats.text: 宮裏上下，也是喝出病來的。
beats.en: At court too, high and low drank themselves ill.

beats.text: 這孩兒不妨事，吃兩服藥便好。
beats.en: The child will be fine. Two doses and he's well.
Amitabha! Thank you, physician!

beats.text: 馬行街那邊，也有醫小兒的。
beats.en: Over on Maxing Street there are children's doctors too.

beats.text: 還是太丞穩當，宮裏出來的。
beats.en: This physician is the safe choice. He served at court.
The prescription's written. Fill it at the counter.

beats.text: 借問一聲，投親該往哪走？
beats.en: Excuse me, which way to find my kin?

as.shi: 相公是讀書人，可識得路？
as.tong: 小哥兒，你家可在這左近？
as.jun: 軍爺，小的不是歹人，問個路。

asEn.guan: Pardon me, sir. I've lost my way.
asEn.shi: You're a scholar, sir. Do you know the way?
asEn.seng: Master, may I ask the way?
asEn.fu: Ma'am, the streets of this town are a maze.
asEn.tong: Little one, do you live near here?
asEn.jun: Soldier, I mean no harm. I'm only asking the way.
asEn.li: Brother, may I ask the way?

beats.en: Follow this street, straight on west.
West… the trees close in over there.
There's road beyond the trees. Just keep going.
This road, which way should it go…
This box of cakes is for my relatives.

beats.text: 外方人來，指個路是應當的。
beats.en: A stranger comes, you show him the way. That's only right.
Folk in the capital are decent. Don't be afraid.

beats.text: 背著這包袱，走了一路了。
beats.en: I've carried this bundle the whole way.
There's a stranger at the gate!

beats.text: 這街走到頭，又是甚麼地方？
beats.en: And where does this street end up?

beats.text: 前頭霧濛濛的，我也說不清。
beats.en: It's all haze ahead. I can't rightly say.

beats.text: 認準了路再走，莫走歪了。
beats.en: Be sure of the road, then go. Don't stray.
What's your business?

as.tong: 誰家的孩子？莫在門前耍。

asEn.guan: Come to call on my master, sir?
asEn.shi: Have you come to leave your card, sir?
asEn.seng: Alms, Master? Please try the back door.
asEn.fu: Which house are you looking for, madam?
asEn.tong: Whose child are you? No playing at the gate.

beats.en: The master has just ridden out.
In his broad hat, heading east.
Some house's wine party again, I'll bet.
Then he'll be back needing Physician Zhao.

beats.text: 看這斗拱、這上馬石，就知是誰家。
beats.en: These brackets, this mounting stone: you know whose house.

beats.text: 隔壁醫鋪，倒比咱們熱鬧。
beats.en: The medicine shop next door is busier than we are.
A gatekeeper's job is to sit tight.

beats.text: 那外鄉人又在看招牌了。
beats.en: That stranger's reading the signs again.
Country folk. Never seen the like.
I want to go out and look too!
Back inside. Don't trip on the threshold.
You ahead there, make way.

asEn.shi: Young man, are you sitting the exams?
asEn.li: Stand aside. Don't block the road.

beats.en: Make way, the official's coming!
Sit tight, sir. Crowds ahead.
Sir, shall I open the parasol?
The sun's not strong. Keep it folded.

beats.text: 這傘扛了一路，肩都酸了。
beats.en: Carried this parasol the whole way. My shoulder aches.

beats.text: 官人，往正店去，還是回府？
beats.en: Sir, to the wine house, or home?

beats.text: 先去孫羊店，吃一盞再說。
beats.en: The Sun Yang house first. A cup, then we'll see.
We'll be waiting till dark again.

beats.text: 滿街的馬，不是坐騎，就是拉酒。
beats.en: Every horse in the street is a mount or hauls wine.
Long years of peace. What use are warhorses?
Best not answer that.

altsEn: Excuse me, which way to my kin's?
Could you point me the way?
Excuse me, how do I go west?
Follow this street, straight on west.
West, past that old willow.
Thank you for your help!
I see. Thank you.
'For harm done by wine: true remedy, Incense Pills'…
This sign says it cures harm from wine?

alts: 前頭正店腳店，天天滿座。
城裏酒肆多，喝傷的也多。
altsEn: The wine houses and taverns ahead are full every day.
Many taverns in town, and many hurt by drink.

alts: 鄉下人一年也醉不了幾回。
喝酒喝出病，城裏人真闊。
altsEn: Back home we're drunk only a few times a year.
Drinking yourself sick: town folk are rich.
Busy at the gate today.
The master's gone out. We can rest.

alts: 隔壁醫鋪，又來了看病的。
altsEn: More patients at the medicine shop next door.
Good. A bit of sun, then.
What's that man carrying on his back?
There's a stranger outside.
Back inside. Stop peeking.
Stay in. Lots of horses out here.

alts: 問路的人，一年比一年多。
altsEn: This road, where does it lead…
More people asking the way every year.

alts: 前頭樹合攏了，霧濛濛的。
altsEn: Ahead the trees close in, all haze.
Walk to the end and you can't see a thing.

alts: 孩兒哭了一宿，不肯吃奶。
altsEn: Physician, the child had a fever in the night.
Physician, please look at this child.
The child cried all night and won't feed.
Don't fret. Let me feel the brow.
Easy now. Let me have a look.
Mama…
Waaah —

alts: 還有我家丈夫，昨夜又醉了。
順帶給我家丈夫抓些藥。
altsEn: And my husband got drunk again last night.
Some medicine for my husband too, while we're here.

alts: 門外牌上寫著：治酒所傷。
altsEn: The sign outside says it: for harm done by wine.
Incense Pills, made for harm done by wine.
In this town, which house doesn't drink?
Out of town at Qingming, who doesn't get drunk?

alts: 宮裏上下，也是喝出病來的。
altsEn: At court too, high and low drank themselves ill.
This whole street smells of wine.

alts: 太丞是宮裏出來的，信得過。
馬行街那邊，也有醫小兒的。
altsEn: The physician served at court. You can trust him.
Over on Maxing Street there are children's doctors too.
This physician is the safe choice.
This is the house we trust.
The Five Strains and Seven Injuries, those too.
The prescription's written. Fill it at the counter.
That abacus clacks away.
And who knows what the doctoring will cost.
Make way, make way!
You ahead, step aside!
Sit tight, sir.
Easy, crowds ahead.
Lively on the street today.
A fine spring day.
Sir, shall I open the parasol?
The sun's up. Open the parasol?
No need. Keep it folded.
No hurry. When we get there.

alts: 這傘扛了一路，肩都酸了。
altsEn: Carried this parasol the whole way. My shoulder aches.
Walking behind a horse wears your legs thin.
Less talk. The master can hear.
Shh, don't let the master hear.

alts: 這馬，也只配馱官人逛街。
altsEn: Not one warhorse in the whole town.
This horse is only fit for carrying the master about.
Sir, to the wine house?
Sir, home, perhaps?
A cup first, then we'll see.
Home. No wine today.

alts: 藥鋪煎藥，一日要幾擔水。
altsEn: Up — this load of water's heavy.
The medicine shop brews all day. It takes loads of water.
Clear well water, just right for brewing medicine.
Coming through, coming through.
Heavy load. Make way.
These two baskets bite into the shoulder.
Hold it tight. Don't let anyone lift it.
Crowded. Hold the bundle close.
